title: Anh/chị gõ vào điện thoại giúp tôi được không?
englishTitle: Please type it into my phone.
pronunciation: Anh chi go vao dien thoai giup toi duoc khong
summary: For handing over your phone so a price, address, name, or instruction can be typed instead of repeated.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Anh/chị gõ vào điện thoại giúp tôi được không? is enough to start the next practical step.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Hand over the keyboard only after they agree; keep the field ready.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: This asks for typed help politely, without sounding like an order.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: I don’t understand, Can you speak a little slower, and Could you speak a little slower, please.

phrases.english: Can you speak a little slower?

phrases.vietnamese: Nói chậm giúp tôi được không?

phrases.pronunciation: noy chuhm zoop toy dook khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good when spelling, pronunciation, noise, or fast speech is blocking the exact detail you need to keep.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Open the note, map, or message field first so the request feels easy to answer.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the answer moves on, move to please say that again, please write it down, and what does that mean?
